description: This file defines a static enum 'GatewaySettingsStore' that manages persistent storage and retrieval of gateway configuration settings, tokens, IDs, and related data using Keychain and UserDefaults. It also includes the 'GatewayDiagnostics' class for logging diagnostics information for Gateway operations.
external_methods: KeychainStore.saveString(_ value: String, service: String, account: String) -> Bool

classes.name: GatewayDiagnostics
classes.description: A utility class for logging diagnostic messages related to the Gateway, maintaining a log file with size management, and providing methods to bootstrap, log messages, and reset logs.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the diagnostics logging system, truncating old logs if necessary, and starting the log with a timestamp.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp to both the console logger and the diagnostics log file.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes the existing diagnostics log file, effectively resetting the logs.
